payload.description:
After the SSE spike records its result (chatticus-bbfb8d), do the 30-minute diagram step. Do not start this while Test 1 is still open.

Decision (Grok recommendation, adopted):

- Primary: hand-authored mermaid in the existing source-of-truth doc. Roles, not CDK logical IDs. No AWS icon posters, no cdk-dia, no Icepanel, no Workload Discovery (idle floor / drift).
- One picture for the computerless turn: replace the ASCII block in docs/MESSAGING.md. Delete the duplicate ASCII in DESIGN_CHALLENGES challenge 1 (link to MESSAGING). If front-door placement is still open, keep a generic Front door box; do not draw CloudFront as the product.
- Do not diagram ChatticusSseSpike as architecture. Destroy or leave it unmarked.
- Do not add docs/architecture/. Do not fail CI on diagrams.
- Diagrams 2 (summon/hydrate) and 3 (host ranking) wait until that code is about to land. Not this task.

Acceptance: one mermaid in MESSAGING, no new doc file, no generated PNG as source of truth.
payload.title: Replace the MESSAGING ASCII turn picture with one mermaid after Test 1
